extracted.intended_audience: prospective Knight-Hennessy Scholars applicants (and applicants to Stanford graduate degree programs)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and requirements for applying to the Knight-Hennessy Scholars program concurrently with a full-time Stanford graduate degree program application, including required materials, deadlines, and policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Concurrent Stanford graduate degree enrollment requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Each incoming Knight-Hennessy scholar must also apply to, be accepted by, and enroll in a full-time Stanford graduate degree program unless already offered and deferred admission or a first-year Stanford PhD student applying in the second year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unless you already have an offer deferred or are a first-year Stanford PhD applying in year two, you must submit separate applications: one to Knight-Hennessy Scholars (KHS) and one (or more) to your desired Stanford graduate degree program(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: KHS application purpose criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: The Knight-Hennessy Scholars application invites you to demonstrate independence of thought, purposeful leadership, and a civic mindset.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frame your KHS materials (essays, short answers, statements) to show these qualities; admissions evaluation will look for evidence of these attributes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stanford graduate program application purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: The Stanford graduate degree program application(s) invites you to demonstrate your qualifications specific to your intended program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program applications focus on discipline-specific fit and qualifications; tailor those materials to the academic program's expectations rather than solely to KHS criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application deadlines and timing
rubrics_metrics.description: KHS application opens June 1, 2026; KHS application deadline October 6, 2026 at 1:00 pm Pacific Time. Degree program deadlines vary by program and applicants must consult programs directly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You must meet both KHS and the Stanford degree program deadlines. Check each degree program's deadline carefully because some program-specific deadlines may differ; KHS lists notification dates for internal stages (video invitations in January, finalists notified Jan 27, 2027, scholars notified Mar 16, 2027).

rubrics_metrics.name: Required application materials
rubrics_metrics.description: KHS requires an online application form, resume, transcript & test scores, recommendation letters, and short answers & essay.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit all Knight-Hennessy application materials in English via the online application portal. Do not send materials via email or postal mail. Some items (transcripts, resume) may be identical across KHS and degree program applications, but prepare them to satisfy each application's requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Test score policy
rubrics_metrics.description: KHS follows the practices of your graduate degree program(s): if the graduate program does not require standardized tests, you do not need to submit any with your KHS application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If your graduate degree program requires test scores, you must report them to Knight-Hennessy Scholars by the later of the graduate program's application deadline or the KHS application deadline. Consult your graduate program(s) directly for their testing requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application fee policy and waivers
rubrics_metrics.description: There is no application fee for Knight-Hennessy Scholars; most Stanford graduate degree programs require a fee to apply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: KHS cannot provide application fee waivers for degree program applications. For fee waiver information, applicants should consult Stanford Graduate Admissions and the degree program directly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acknowledgement of concurrent application
rubrics_metrics.description: You must acknowledge the other application in both places: indicate Stanford degree program(s) in your KHS application and indicate you are applying to KHS in your Stanford degree program application(s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This coordination ensures programs and KHS are aware of concurrent applications; follow each application's instructions for where/how to indicate the other application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Separate review processes
rubrics_metrics.description: KHS applications are reviewed by the KHS Admission committee; Stanford degree program applications are reviewed by the respective admission committees for those programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: KHS does not review degree program applications or associated documents, and materials are not shared between committees except in rare cases where sharing may aid evaluation. KHS will check with Stanford departments/programs to verify which applicants have submitted degree program applications and remain competitive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application submission and editing restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: You will not be able to edit your KHS application once you submit it, with limited exceptions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editable items after submission via your Application Status page include: adding test scores, changing recommenders, uploading an updated resume, and changing your intended Stanford graduate degree program(s). Plan and proof materials before final submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommender timing and management
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter recommenders’ information in your applications as early as possible to give recommenders ample time to submit their letters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You may change recommenders after submission via the Application Status page. Consider whether recommenders should write separate letters for KHS and degree programs; the site suggests you may or may not want the same recommenders for both.

rubrics_metrics.name: Language and submission format requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: All Knight-Hennessy Scholars application materials must be submitted in English via the online application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: KHS does not accept materials sent via email or postal mail. The site recommends using a current version of Google Chrome or Mozilla Firefox to complete the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility: degree equivalency
rubrics_metrics.description: To be eligible for graduate study, you must have earned a U.S. bachelor's degree or its equivalent from a college or university of recognized standing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to Stanford's guidelines for minimum level of study. For questions about eligibility or interpretation of equivalency, contact the Office of Graduate Admissions (not KHS).

rubrics_metrics.name: Applying to multiple Stanford programs
rubrics_metrics.description: You may apply to more than one graduate degree program at Stanford, though policies vary and you may be unable to apply to more than one academic program simultaneously in most cases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If planning multiple program applications, review Stanford Graduate Admissions policies and each program's guidance to confirm whether simultaneous applications are permitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distinctness and overlap between KHS and program applications
rubrics_metrics.description: While a distinct approach to each application is encouraged, content may overlap if it satisfies requirements for both applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some materials (transcripts, resume) may be identical; essays/personal statements should answer each prompt and therefore may need to be different. Consider tailoring recommenders and essays to the specific goals of KHS (leadership, civic mindset) versus program-specific academic fit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application preparation process (stepwise guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommended steps: create concurrent KHS and degree program application(s) early, enter recommender information early, complete sections saving progress, prepare materials that take longer (essays/personal statements), and submit by respective deadlines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not rely on being able to edit the KHS application after submission (exceptions apply). Allow ample time for recommenders and for collecting transcripts or test scores. If you receive new test scores after submitting, update them via your KHS Application Status page if the program requires tests.
